patchNotes.title: Remote snapshot replacement
patchNotes.text: A successful GitHub refresh replaces the old remote feed snapshot instead of merging with it, allowing deleted and edited entries to update correctly.

patchNotes.title: Numeric update IDs
patchNotes.text: Update ordering uses the numeric id inside update.json. Missing numbers and IDs beyond 9999 are supported.

patchNotes.title: Visible update switch
patchNotes.text: Set visible to false in update.json to keep an update folder in GitHub while hiding it from CeyBlox News Center and latest-version detection.

patchNotes.title: Addon version safety
patchNotes.text: Only installed addons with a matching version entry are compared. Missing or uninstalled addon entries do not create warnings.
